g.text: How close are rcp defaults to the best tested setting?
Extra elapsed time = (default mean / smallest tested rcp mean − 1) × 100; 0% means default had the lowest mean.
Best is selected from automatic, 8, 32 and 128 for each cell; it is an observed minimum, not a proven optimum.
Three successful runs per setting; this view shows descriptive ratios, not uncertainty or statistical significance.
The first three columns contain ~1 TB; 1 kB contains 10.24 GB. Linux source has no tuning sweep and is excluded.
ZFS ARC effects could not be fully excluded, including metadata caching.
